description: Where an avatar creation stands: status, what awaits review and the previews (image and movements) to show the user. Without jobId, lists recent creations ("continue my avatar"). Free. Generation takes minutes: do not poll in a loop; the user gets an email when there is something to review.

jobId.description: The job id from criar_avatar or ver_andamento.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.
